content_sections.heading: Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification and professional experience requirements prescribed for the respective positions. The recruitment is mainly targeted towards experienced professionals having backgrounds in banking, finance, treasury management, business development and information technology. The candidate should have sound knowledge of investment operations, liquidity management, fund management, regulatory compliance and treasury-related risk management.

content_sections.heading: Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026 Experience Details
content_sections.text: The Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026 is mainly for experienced professionals. Candidates must possess relevant banking, treasury, business development or IT experience depending on the position applied for. Minimum 10 years of experience in Treasury Management in a Nationalized Bank, reputed Private Bank or Co-operative Bank. The candidate should have sound knowledge of: Investment operations Liquidity management Fund management Regulatory compliance Treasury-related risk management Minimum 12 years of banking experience . At least 5 years of experience in: Business Development Sales Management Branch Leadership Liability Mobilisation Retail/Corporate Banking Experience in cooperative banking will be preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in Information Technology after acquiring the minimum prescribed qualification. At least 5 years of experience in: Scheduled Commercial Bank Urban Co-operative Bank Small Finance Bank Payments Bank NBFC Financial Institution IT vendor/system integrator servicing BFSI clients Minimum 3 years of supervisory experience in IT leadership roles. Hands-on experience with Core Banking Solution environment, preferably Finacle, will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Mehsana Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026 Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Manage cash and funds of the Bank efficiently. Calculate, analyse and project returns on investment products. Monitor the Bank’s investment portfolio according to applicable policies and regulations. Plan business plans, liquidity plans and risk management strategies related to treasury operations. Handle Bank funds through the Treasury Department. Assist in financial strategy development and implementation. Ensure compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements. Manage and coordinate activities of the Treasury Department. Formulate and implement the Bank's business growth strategy. Set business targets for zones, regions, branches and products. Monitor deposits, advances, CASA, retail assets, MSME, gold loan and fee-based income targets. Develop customer acquisition and relationship strengthening strategies. Review branch performance and recommend corrective measures. Identify business opportunities and expansion prospects. Drive cross-selling initiatives. Present business performance and strategic recommendations before management and the Board. Support the GM & CTO in IT strategy, architecture and governance. Manage Core Banking Solution environment, digital delivery channels, Data Centre and Disaster Recovery systems. Monitor IT infrastructure, networks and technology operations. Ensure compliance with banking technology standards and regulatory requirements. Support cybersecurity controls and IT audit requirements. Lead and supervise the Information Technology Department.
